title: FBI Photo A008
sensor_system_note: A-series — different sensor system from B-series. Small '+' reticle with horizontal tick row, NO timestamp visible, '5' scale mark only. A001-A006 are aerial terrain views (sensor pointed down at ground). A007 is the polarity-anomaly frame (sky background, bright specular target). A008 is sky background with normal dark-on-light polarity. Treat as adjacent-not-paired with B-series.

pages.image_type: grayscale targeting or surveillance display screenshot
pages.description: A monochrome image resembling a thermal or electro-optical targeting display with a crosshair/reticle centered in the frame. The central crosshair consists of vertical and horizontal lines with graduated tick marks (a scale reticle), and a small dark dot appears just right of the center. The background shows a grainy gray field with faint diagonal streaks or terrain-like texture. Numerous black rectangular redaction or overlay bars are placed around the edges—across the top, left side, right side, and bottom—obscuring portions of the display. A small number '5' is visible on the right portion of the horizontal reticle scale.

observations.claim: A crosshair reticle with tick marks is centered in the image

The numeral '5' appears on the right side of the horizontal reticle

The background has a grainy texture with faint diagonal streaks

other_frame_features.background: SKY-like (similar to A007's atmospheric background but with normal dark-on-light polarity)
